rows.title: Q2
rows.synopsis: Janeway is left responsible for Q's mischievous, omnipotent son, whose actions cause widespread trouble.

rows.title: The Cloud
rows.synopsis: After Voyager becomes trapped inside a living nebula, Janeway leads an effort to repair the damage her ship caused.

rows.title: The Omega Directive
rows.synopsis: Voyager is forced out of warp when it detects a dangerous particle called Omega, whose properties are linked to subspace.

rows.title: Time and Again
rows.synopsis: Voyager investigates the destruction of a pre-warp world and the possibility that visiting its recent past caused the disaster.

rows.title: In the Flesh
rows.synopsis: Voyager's crew discovers that Species 8472 operates a simulation of Starfleet Headquarters.

rows.title: Initiations
rows.synopsis: A young Kazon warrior abducts Chakotay while attempting to prove himself to his people.

rows.title: Investigations
rows.synopsis: Following erratic behavior, Tom Paris abandons Voyager and takes passage with a Talaxian convoy.

rows.title: Virtuoso
rows.synopsis: The Doctor finds that his passion for music starts influencing matters in his personal life.

rows.title: Ashes to Ashes
rows.synopsis: An alien seeking refuge aboard Voyager claims to be one of the ship's long-deceased crew members.

rows.title: Jetrel
rows.synopsis: Neelix must confront painful memories when the scientist behind the weapon that devastated his homeworld visits Voyager.

rows.title: The Q and the Grey
rows.synopsis: Unusual supernovas herald a conflict within the Q Continuum, drawing Voyager into an escalating crisis.

rows.title: Think Tank
rows.synopsis: A Hazari ambush leaves Voyager facing an apparently inescapable threat.
